findings.issue: The grid seeds `definition` from `?definition=` ONLY in the useState initializer, which runs once on mount. There is no effect syncing searchParams→state afterward. In the specified anti-case the deep-link always originates from /process-catalog (fresh mount of ProcessesScreen), so it works. But an in-grid `?definition=` change or browser back/forward while already on /processes would leave the filter desynced from the URL.
findings.suggestion: Optional follow-up: add a `useEffect([searchParams])` that syncs the definition filter when the URL param changes without a remount. Not required for the current C→B flow.

findings.issue: On deep-link arrival the filter IS applied (definition state seeded, fetch already filtered), but `<select value={definition}>` has no matching <option> until the async GET /api/process-catalog options resolve, so the dropdown briefly shows blank instead of the definition name. Self-heals when options load; the filter is never silently dropped. Honest, not a dead state.
findings.suggestion: Cosmetic only. Could show the seeded key as a transient option label until names load; low value.

findings.issue: LIVE_PROOF deferred — stand offline at handoff. The C→B navigation, modeler/DMN entry points, trigger upsert, and (critically) that the grid's ?definition= filter counts the SAME instances the card's instance_count advertises are proven only by unit/source tests + build, not a live browser pass. A '3 инстанса' link that lands on a grid showing a different count would be a jarring (non-fatal) mismatch.
findings.suggestion: Before promote dev→main, run the D-064 live pass on the stand: open /process-catalog, click a >0 counter, confirm the grid lands pre-filtered and the count agrees; open modeler + branch-rules + a trigger save. Plan is already in the pr-handoff.
